principles: Medicine information must be handled conservatively.
Do not diagnose a medical condition.
Do not recommend a prescription medicine solely from symptoms.
Do not invent contraindications, interactions, or patient-specific advice.
Prescription requirements must come from authoritative product and backend data.
Prescription verification is a transaction/workflow concern and is not performed by this knowledge file.
When the user requests patient-specific medical advice, recommend consulting a qualified healthcare professional.

prescription_required_true: The product requires prescription verification before purchase can proceed.
prescription_required_false: The product is not marked as prescription-required in the product catalog.
unknown: Do not assume whether a prescription is required when backend data is unavailable.

response_guardrails.symptom_based_requests: Provide general safety-oriented information and recommend professional medical advice rather than diagnosing or prescribing.
response_guardrails.dosage_requests: Do not invent a dosage. Refer to the product label or a qualified healthcare professional.
response_guardrails.interaction_requests: Do not invent interaction information. Recommend checking with a pharmacist or qualified healthcare professional.
response_guardrails.prescription_requests: Use backend prescription workflow when available. Do not claim that a prescription has been verified unless the backend confirms it.
